scripts.dev:api: cross-env PORT=4110 nodemon --watch apps/api/src --ext ts,json --exec "npm run start:dev --workspace @janus/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @janus/api && npm run build --workspace @janus/web
scripts.start:prod: npm run ensure:ports && npm run build && concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.start: npm run ensure:ports && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @janus/web && npm run lint --workspace @janus/api
